newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB says to leave Jan prime rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: LTCB says to leave Jan prime rate unchanged.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd said on Thursday it would leave its long-term prime lending rate for January unchanged at the current record low of 2.5 percent.
The bank also said it would leave the coupon rate for its January five-year debentures, the bank's major fund-raising tool, at 1.8 percent, unchanged from the December issue.

The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ), the largest of Japan's three long-term credit banks, said on Wednesday it would leave its long-term prime lending rate for January unchanged at a record low of 2.5 percent.
The prime rate is applied to loans of one year and longer to the long-term credit banks' most creditworthy clients. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk (81-33432-8570)
